approach-mandatory-custom-injection.reason: Mandatory injection transfers the ordinary default-safety obligation to every application and removes working default initialization even on hosts with cryptographic UUID support. Validating host randomness on the default path fixes the unsafe sequence without requiring all consumers to design a provider.
